name: kampalo
description: Kampalo for Grok Bot: read synced ads/SEO/GA4 data, propose and confirm campaign pauses, manage alert and automation rules, and generate report JSON.

KAMPALO_MCP_URL.title: Kampalo MCP URL
KAMPALO_MCP_URL.description: Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint. Local Docker default is http://127.0.0.1:8100/mcp. For Grok Bot, use a host-reachable URL of the same FastMCP server (python manage.py run_mcp_server). Do not invent a path.

KAMPALO_MCP_API_KEY.title: Kampalo MCP API key
KAMPALO_MCP_API_KEY.description: Bearer token matching backend MCP_API_KEY. Required when the server has auth enabled. Leave empty only for a local unauthenticated MCP (not recommended).
